_comment: Known gaps shown by jarvis-status. Edited here, not in the script, so closing a gap is a data change rather than a code change. A gap NEVER makes the overall status FAIL -- it is a documented limitation, not a fault.

gaps.note: Detector and audio pipeline are alive, but intentional-user recall and ambient false-positive rate are not yet reliable. Evidence 2026-09-02: openWakeWord running, feed_errors=0, and a detector-origin wake was observed firing on its own at 13:32:20 (PEAK_RMS=130, no speech) -- so the engine fires. What it missed was a deliberate "Hey Jarvis" earlier the same session. This is calibration, not a dead engine. Cmd+Shift+J remains the reliable path. No threshold or model change has been made.
Recovery from a clamshell sleep/wake cycle has never been observed.
The readiness-aware startup warm passed a controlled race test (ollama absent at runtime start, bound 7s later). A real logout/login has not yet exercised it.
A turn started while the startup warm is still retrying is unmeasured. Argued safe -- Ollama serves one runner per model -- but not observed.
